scenarios.name: crash_after_stage_before_commit
scenarios.action: SIGKILL after staging write, before commit
scenarios.recovery: staging blob detected as orphan, cleaned on next recover()

scenarios.name: crash_during_commit
scenarios.action: SIGKILL mid-commit (temp file created but rename pending)
scenarios.recovery: temp file has no committed marker; treated as orphan, cleaned

scenarios.name: crash_after_commit_visible
scenarios.action: SIGKILL after commit (version visible to readers)

note: Artifact FS uses same atomic-rename protocol as Phase B.1; sigkill coverage inherited from kernel tests
